resources.string: A little help, one step at a time.
Open family, apps or alarms. You choose the person and review any call or message.
What would you like to do?
Thinking… You can stop at any time.
Stopped. Your text is ready to edit.
Try “family”, “apps”, “alarm”, “WhatsApp” or “home”. You can also choose a button below.
The request could not finish. Your text is still here. Try again or choose a button.
Money requests need a separate review.
Type a request or tap Speak first.
Please keep your request under 1,000 characters.
Your phone’s speech service may send your voice to its provider. Listening starts only when you ask to speak. You can type instead.
Allow microphone access, then tap Speak again.
Speech recognition is unavailable. Please type your request.
The complete request was not heard. Tap Speak to try again, or type.

After you submit a request, requests that need AI can send the text in this box to %1$s. No screen, photo or contact list is included. Your configured provider may process or retain the text. You can turn this off here at any time.
A caregiver must configure a valid HTTPS assistant address first. Family, apps, alarms and Home still work locally.
Optional AI is off. Local buttons remain available.
Floating helper is visible · Turn off
Allow Maa to display over other apps, then return and tap Turn on.
The floating helper could not start. Check its permission and try again.
Your assistant, Family and Home are available from the floating helper.
Drag to move. Accessibility actions also move the helper.
